identity.name: GuyaneConnect
identity.core_concept: Jungle logistics meets community warmth. A fusion of Swiss precision (for the map/tracking) and Caribbean vibrancy (for the human connection).

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-6 or p-8 where p-4 is normal.
layout.grid_system: Mobile-first. Single column for phone, 'Bento' grid for tablet/desktop.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all active:scale-95 font-semibold tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border-2 border-primary/10 rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-stone-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-stone-50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl h-12 px-4 transition-all

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to reduce 'digital flatness'

instructions_to_main_agent: OVERRIDE tailwind.config.js colors with the palette provided above. Do not use the default 'hsl(var(--primary))' logic unless you update the CSS variables to match these hex codes.
Use 'Clash Display' for all headings. If not available via standard import, use a bold, wide sans-serif like 'Syne' or 'Outfit'.
For the Map View: Ensure the map container is z-0 and absolute. All UI elements (search, bottom sheet) must float above it with glassmorphism.
For Forms: Do not use default browser inputs. Use the custom 'inputs' style defined in components.
For Toasts: Use 'sonner' with the 'richColors' prop enabled.
Mobile First: Always design for 375px width first, then scale up.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element (buttons, inputs, cards).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
